Use case: precise-object-edit. Return one corrected COMPLETE portrait card. Image1 exact rejected full-resolution PNG is editing target. Image2 unchanged original small card is sole authority for actual pose, crop, clothes, source hair and light. Image3 user mascot identity and compact round anatomy only.
Correct only the pointed yellow lower-head V above the grey necktie. Replace the long taper with one compact near-round head and clearly ROUNDED SHORT U-shaped chin close below the closed mouth, meeting a RAISED/BROADENED real white shirt collar with minimal throat exposure. Broaden and raise both collar sides coherently; correct cloth overlap/contact shadow. No long yellow jaw, separate neck shaft, triangular funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, clipping, floating fabric or cream belly bib. Preserve original mild image-left angle/head roll, do not turn frontal to hide the geometry.
Preserve short neatly side-parted dark brown/black hair and actual brow hair, clean understated upper lip/chin with no invented moustache/beard, serious closed mouth, green-ringed black eyes, actual dark navy OPEN civilian jacket, WHITE/PALE shirt and small DARK GREY necktie. No hat, glasses or uniform. Fine upper-lip shadow remains understated.
Keep exact primary lighting, complete tilted dark frame, OPAQUE photographic backing in its original color and lower-right cream note with faint indistinct marks and exact overlap. All internal skin, hair/fur, cloth, fittings, frame, backing and note stay opaque. Genuine alpha only outside complete original card silhouette. No invented figures, badges, readable text, symbols, watermark or comparison sheet.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
